title_original: Patrick Stewart Photos: His Film & TV Career Through The Decades

blocks.text: Sir Patrick Stewart, whose distinctive voice helped him embody everything from USS Enterprise Captain Jean-Luc Picard to the X-Men’s Professor X to Ebenezer Scrooge to an emoji, has died .
His decades-long career spans the stage, the big screen, TV and commercials. He worked across genres from sci-fi to Shakespeare, to historical dramas to superhero films to comedy and animation.
